ab.title: A/B gate
ab.ok: A/B gate: OK (%(count)d pairs, no confounding variables)
ab.off: off (%(name)s does not exist ⇒ says so and exits 0; pluggable)
ab.explicit_spec_missing: explicitly specified spec %(name)s does not exist (--spec / REFLECT_AB) — write the spec or drop the flag
ab.empty: pairs is empty (zero-value guard: an empty assertion surface is not a pass)
ab.pair_missing_field: pair missing field %(field)s: %(entry)r (why is mandatory — an unexplained comparison nobody dares to delete)
ab.confound: %(name)s: confounding variable — %(key)s key %(field)r: A=%(value_a)r B=%(value_b)r (non-allow axis differs ⇒ A/B is void)
ab.artifact_unreadable: %(name)s: artifact unreadable (%(error_a)s / %(error_b)s) ⇒ not checked this run
ab.not_a_dict: %(name)s: key=%(key)r is not a dict in at least one of the two artifacts
